decisions.reason: Existing ordinary kin registration is bounded after the last genuine merit; entries after lost titles can later hold real offices. Preserve those opportunities. Optimize per-update lookup and birth authority preflight; retain strict source checks. No deletion, ban or new political-family authority fields.
decisions.politicalExpansion: Existing real military usurper is preferred after the existing successful revolution opportunity when office, actual troops>=2, service>=60 months, strength>=2, capture, different established house and ambition>loyalty qualify. Otherwise the existing abstract successor route remains. Future civil participation needs actual office, city influence, lawful supporters and crisis evidence; no invented army and no probability change in z64.
futureOnly: rebel founder previous occupations with real evidence
historical city memorials without automatic city creation
decisions.nameCulture: Frozen civil name culture and real royal house are auditable; ordinary military culture is not independently persisted and remains UNRECORDED. No ethnic population percentage or demographic rule changes.

limitations: The original user Ying Xuan save was not supplied; root cause is verified through code, a natural same-identity baseline case and controlled production Core, not an asserted exact replay.
Long runs reuse fixed seed prefixes; there are eight independent seeds, not seventeen independent worlds.

P0 intentionally changes political target records and same-name wording. Whole-version state equality is not claimed; allowed differences are listed and no non-history authority changes occurred in these runs.
The performance fixture uses naturally produced V59 and V60 native saves with the same canonical world apart from version labels; no header patching or player-save migration.
Final timing runs are serial on one machine; unrelated user applications are untouched. Electron offscreen controls and frame metrics are not human visual acceptance.
Render CPU hooks do not measure GPU time; long-task observations include save restoration between frame windows and cannot diagnose GC by themselves.
No forced family dormancy policy is published. Read-only classifications do not prevent normal residence, recruitment or later real merit.
